advancements.bpm.alloy.title: Coherent Metallurgy

advancements.bpm.circuit.title: Entangled Logic
advancements.bpm.controller.description: Build a Quantum Controller around the core and automate the world.
advancements.bpm.controller.title: Quantum Supremacy

advancements.bpm.core.title: Claimed

advancements.bpm.frame.title: Containment
advancements.bpm.gate.description: Seat a Quantum Gate projector on top of a complete frame.
advancements.bpm.gate.title: Gatekeeper
advancements.bpm.linker.description: Craft a Quantum Linker and bind the world to your programs.
advancements.bpm.linker.title: Linked
advancements.bpm.pristine.description: Claim a Pristine Quantum Core — the Warden's rarest heart.
advancements.bpm.pristine.title: Pristine
advancements.bpm.regalia.description: Collect the Warden's Visor, Phase Gauntlet, Entangled Compass and Warden's Program.
advancements.bpm.regalia.title: Warden's Regalia

advancements.bpm.root.title: Entangled
advancements.bpm.warden.title: Observer Collapsed
bpm.collection_log.title: Collection Log
bpm.jei.warden.note: Cores are not crafted. Beat the Warden, then claim the core from its pedestal.
bpm.jei.warden.note_fast: Finish the fight quickly and the odds shift up a tier.
bpm.ponder.bpm_assembler.text_1: The Quantum Assembler makes what a crafting grid cannot.
bpm.ponder.bpm_assembler.text_2: Ingredients rest on Core Pedestals within 2 blocks, in any arrangement.
bpm.ponder.bpm_assembler.text_3: Power and liquid experience are fed in from underneath. Leave the block below it clear.
bpm.ponder.bpm_assembler.text_4: Feed it the exact rate the recipe asks for. Too little or too much and the job decoheres.
bpm.ponder.bpm_assembler.text_5: Hand it the catalyst last. That starts the job, and the result drops on top when it is done.
bpm.ponder.bpm_links.header: Linking blocks to a Quantum Controller
bpm.ponder.bpm_links.text_1: A Quantum Controller reaches out to blocks instead of touching them.
bpm.ponder.bpm_links.text_2: Click a block with the Quantum Linker to link it. Its name is how a graph refers to it.
bpm.ponder.bpm_links.text_3: The face you click is remembered. A machine that only accepts power from one side must be linked on that side.
bpm.ponder.bpm_links.text_4: The core's tier sets how far it reaches and how many links it can hold.
